biography.value: An abyssal lord of despair ruling from the corpse-fields of Helheim. Vorath hovers above the battlefield, drowning the brave in dread, paralyzing the mighty with his gaze, and rending the living with his Shadow Fork while raising the fallen as his undead thralls. He is a 10th-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).

description.value: If Vorath fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When Vorath fails a saving throw.

description.value: Reaction. When Vorath is hit by an attack, he can use his reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. He immediately becomes invisible until the start of his next turn or until he attacks.
description.chat: Vorath dissolves into mist and reappears elsewhere!

activation.condition: When Vorath is hit by an attack.

description.value: Vorath becomes invisible until the start of his next turn or until he attacks.

Creatures of Vorath's choice within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or be frightened until the end of their next turn. While frightened this way, they take 10 (3d6) psychic damage at the start of their turn.
description.chat: A wave of crushing despair rolls out from Vorath!

activation.condition: At the start of each creature's turn while within 15 feet of Vorath.

effects.name: Aura of Despair
effects.description: You are &reference[frightened apply=false] of Vorath until the end of your next turn. At the start of your turn while frightened this way, take [[/r 3d6]] psychic damage (apply with the Modify button).

description.value: As an action, Vorath can force a creature he can see within 30 feet to make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
description.chat: Vorath's burning gaze locks you in place!

effects.name: Dreadful Gaze: Paralyzed
effects.description: You are &reference[paralyzed apply=false] until the end of your next turn.

description.value: Vorath makes three attacks: one with his Shadow Fork and two with his Necrotic Grasp.
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and Vorath regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
description.chat: Vorath skewers you with his fork of living shadow!

description.value: Vorath regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (8d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.
description.chat: Withered talons of negative energy claw at your soul!

description.value: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, until it finishes a long rest.

effects.name: Necrotic Grasp: Max HP Reduced
effects.description: Your hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage dealt by Vorath's Necrotic Grasp. Apply the reduction manually with the Modify button, then remove this effect at the end of a long rest. This is a placeholder effect and does not track the exact amount.

description.value: Vorath creates an explosion of shadowy tendrils in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are blinded until the end of their next turn.

effects.name: Dark Burst: Blinded
effects.description: You are &reference[blinded apply=false] until the end of your next turn.

description.value:
Vorath is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): [[/item .VorEldritchBlast1]]{eldritch blast}

3rd level (1 slot): [[/item .VorAnimateDead01]]{animate dead}

5th level (1 slot): [[/item .VorCloudkill0001]]{cloudkill}, [[/item .VorDominateP001]]{dominate person}
description.chat: Vorath is a spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma.

description.value: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. Additional beams at higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th. You can direct the beams at the same target or different ones, rolling separately for each.

This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse. On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. The creature is under your control for 24 hours. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd.

materials.value: A drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

description.value: Raise a corpse as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NAISFPoNNgUCsEyW]{zombie} under Vorath's control for 24 hours.
Cantrip. Vorath regains hit points equal to [[/r 1d8 + 6]] (1d8 + his Charisma modifier). Usable a number of times equal to his proficiency bonus per long rest.
description.chat: Vorath draws on his dark pact to knit his flesh.

description.value: [[lookup @resources.legact.label]]
Legendary Action (1). Vorath casts a spell of 2nd level or lower.
Legendary Action (1). Vorath teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

Legendary Action (2). Each creature of Vorath's choice within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
description.chat: Visions of the corpse-fields of Helheim flood your mind!

effects.name: Horrifying Visage
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] of Vorath for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success.

description.value: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe. The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

activation.condition: When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

description.value: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

effects.name: Dominate Person
effects.description: You are &reference[charmed apply=false] and Vorath has a telepathic link with you. He can issue commands to you, which you must do your best to obey. Each time you take damage, you make a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell; on a success, the spell ends.

description.value: A mote of abyssal flame streaks at one creature Vorath can see within 120 feet: +12 to hit, 3d10 fire damage (6d10 if the target is frightened of Vorath).

Infernal gates flicker open around the chamber. Each creature of Vorath's choice within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Vorath until initiative count 20 on the next round.

The chamber's embers ignite. Each creature within 30 feet of Vorath must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d10 fire damage and catch fire (1d6 fire at the start of each of its turns until someone uses an action to douse it). A successful save negates the damage.

Spectral chains erupt from the throne and lash at one creature Vorath can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be &reference[restrained apply=false] by spectral chains until initiative count 20 on the next round. While restrained this way, the target takes 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.
Vorath dissolves into smoke and re-forms at a point he can see within 60 feet, rising from or sinking into the throne itself.

While Vorath is in his throne room, he can invoke the infernal power of Hellheim to take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing all initiative ties), he takes one lair action; he can't use the same one two rounds in a row:

  • Hellfire Bolt. Vorath hurls a mote of abyssal flame at one creature he can see within 120 feet, a +12 attack dealing 3d10 fire damage (or 6d10 against a creature that is frightened of him).
  • Gates of Dread. Each creature of Vorath's choice within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be &reference[frightened apply=false] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Ember Storm. Vorath ignites the chamber's embers. Each creature within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d10 fire damage and catch fire until someone uses an action to douse it, taking 1d6 fire at the start of each of its turns.
  • Throne of Chains. Spectral chains erupt from the throne, gripping one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be &reference[restrained apply=false] until initiative count 20 on the next round.

effects.name: Gates of Dread: Frightened
effects.description: Frightened of Vorath until initiative count 20 on the next round (repeat the DC 20 Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns; on a success the fear ends).

effects.name: Throne of Chains: Restrained
effects.description: Restrained by spectral chains until initiative count 20 on the next round. Takes 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

description.value:
The region around Vorath's throne is suffused with infernal dread and heat:

Smoldering Air. The air sears the lungs. Creatures other than fiends and undead are vulnerable-feeling: they can't regain hit points, and any creature that starts its turn in the throne room and is at half its hit points or fewer takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

Watchful Dread. The shadows cast by hellfire seem to breathe. Any creature that starts its turn frightened in the throne room takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage as its fear deepens.

Burning Whispers. The braziers murmur names of the dead. Any creature that finishes a long rest in the throne room gains no benefit from it and must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or suffer a nightmarish omen (DM's choice) that haunts it until it receives a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{Greater Restoration}.

If Vorath is slain or banished, these effects fade over 1d10 days.
